subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “At first, some classmates disliked being corrected.”?
options: Administrators learned that "digital first" should not mean "digital only."
The team learned to write politely and explain their method.
Students could write down something kind they saw at school.
When the mistake was found, the newspaper team felt terrible.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Administrators learned that 'digital first' should not mean 'digital only.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「At first, some classmates disliked being corrected. The team learned to write politely and explain their method.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Students could write down something kind they saw at school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「When the mistake was found, the newspaper team felt terrible.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「At first, some classmates disliked being corrected. The team learned to write politely and explain their method.」，答案為「The team learned to write politely and explain their method.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The team learned to write politely and explain their method.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
